description: Sample rate and bit depth reducer for audio or control voltages, with voltage control over both

params.text: Sets the level going into the mangling, reaching 150% at the end of its travel; a low crush setting on a quiet signal can leave nothing at the output
Sets how far the SLICE CV input moves the slice rate, and in which direction
Sets how far the CRUSH CV input moves the number of steps, and in which direction
Sets the rate the input is resampled at; turn it down for coarser slicing
Sets the number of steps the signal is quantised to, 1 to 64; fewer steps gives a coarser, noisier result
Picks the range the input is treated as: -5V to +5V for bipolar signals such as oscillators, or 0-10V for unipolar signals such as envelopes. Anything outside the range is clipped
Picks SLICE for sample rate reduction alone, CRUSH for bit depth reduction alone, or BLEND for both at once

inputs.text: Moves the slice rate from a voltage, scaled by the attenuverter knob that goes with it
Moves the number of crush steps from a voltage, scaled by the attenuverter knob that goes with it
The signal to be mangled; polyphonic, with every channel mangled at the same rate and depth
